title: Prove managed cache and rendition effects before Windows cleanup adoption

criteria.criterion: Trace actual managed backend configuration and all identified cache/rendition callers; distinguish packaged local-only behavior, source-checkout S3 configuration and unverified dynamic/native paths.

Prove supported caller paths cannot mutate a sealed media root or report a false clean drain; retain interrupted/uncertain physical effects, original bytes and journals with real Windows positive/refusal/restart evidence.
Preserve ordinary non-managed storage contracts, run owner/adjacent regressions and required reviewed visuals, and publish exact source/evidence with independent documentation review.
Owner separately authorizes integration and any production deployment; runtime/package adoption and full cleanup acceptance require their own verified gates.

meaning: Open follow-up for later implementation/acceptance, not a closed finding or a change to frozen C109.
